subject: EMD Amount Shortfall — Request for Reconsideration
description: We submitted a Demand Draft of Rs 15,00,000 as EMD. We acknowledge the shortfall against the required Rs 24,00,000 but request reconsideration as this was due to a miscalculation of 0.5% of our estimated bid value rather than the tender estimate. We request permission to submit supplementary EMD of Rs 9,00,000 within 3 working days.
officer_response: Your grievance has been noted. As per the tender terms, EMD must be submitted in full before the submission deadline. The officer committee will review your request and respond within 5 working days.

subject: Ambiguity in OEM Authorization Scope — Clarification Required
description: Section 7.3 of the technical specifications requires OEM authorization for IoT monitoring equipment. However, it is unclear whether this authorization must cover the entire product range or can be scoped to specific equipment models being supplied. Our authorization from SenseNet Technologies B.V. covers the specific models in our bid. Requesting formal clarification on this scope.

subject: ISO 9001 Certificate Incorrectly Flagged for Review
description: The compliance engine has flagged our ISO 9001:2015 certificate as requiring review due to an apparent expiry concern. We wish to clarify that the certificate with expiry date 14-Jan-2025 shown in our upload is an archived version. We have submitted the renewed certificate with validity through January 2028 to our ESIC portal. We request re-classification of this document and removal of the review flag.
